units.source_text: 经过蜜橘园的时候，天色越来越暗了。

en.t: By the time he passed through the mandarin orange grove, the sky was growing darker and darker.
As long as I can stay alive...

units.source_text: 良平抱着这样的信念，顾不上跌倒还是滑倒什么的，只是拼命继续赶路。

en.t: Holding on to that belief, Ryohei paid no attention to whether he stumbled or slipped, and simply kept hurrying on with all his might.
